resources.string: Car hotspot switch (experimental)

The same hotspot startup is used here and before wireless CarPlay. On Android 9, a failed start resets Wi-Fi once before retrying. Disconnect CarPlay first; this can disconnect other Wi-Fi and hotspot devices. Saved hotspot details stay unchanged.
Turn hotspot on
Turn hotspot off
Refresh network state
A network switch operation is in progress. Wait before connecting or trying again.
Finish or disconnect CarPlay and wait for any connection or hotspot startup to end before changing Wi-Fi or the hotspot.
Turning the hotspot off disconnects every device using it and can interrupt CarPlay. Turn it off now?
Hotspot state: on
Hotspot state: off
Hotspot state: starting
Hotspot state: stopping
Hotspot state: failed
Hotspot state: unavailable; use the car settings to check it.
The system refused hotspot control. Check system settings; this app will not grant itself permission.
Direct control is unavailable on this system. Use the car hotspot settings instead.
The requested state was not confirmed before the timeout. Check car settings; no automatic retry was made.
Stopped waiting for the result. A request already sent may still complete; refresh the state before retrying.
The hotspot request failed. Check car settings; no automatic retry was made.
Recover hotspot
Stop the hotspot, check Wi-Fi and cycle it on then off, then try the hotspot once. Wi-Fi will be turned off first only if it is on. This disconnects devices using Wi-Fi or the hotspot.
